notes: POST /api/reviews now requires a 'username' field (the submitter's site account) alongside the existing author_name/rating/body - stored together with their auto-detected IP as moderation-only metadata (Reviews > edit a submitted review > 'Submission info'), never returned by the public GET endpoint. Lets you see who submitted a review and spot one account/IP submitting many. Requires 'Update database' (adds submitted_username/submitted_ip columns to reviews).
